title: App lock
summary: The optional lock that asks for the PIN (or biometrics) when Bipe opens. Off by default; the Bloquear o app switch in Sua conta turns it on (ADR 0137). Also the lock screen itself.

lockOn.description: A device PIN is set on this phone.

biometricOn.description: Biometric unlock is on. Only offered when lockOn and the phone has biometrics.

biometricKind.description: What the phone offers. Names the biometric in bipe_account_biometric_unlock and bipe_app_lock_biometric (Face ID, Touch ID, or bipe_account_biometric_word_android).

phase.description: settings: the rows in Sua conta. creatingPin: the PIN setup after the switch goes on. offerBiometric: the offer after the PIN. locked: the lock screen. wrongPin: a wrong PIN on the lock screen.

pin.description: Digits typed on the lock screen, at most pinLength. Never logged.

turnOn.effect: Opens the signup-pin steps (create and confirm) with the same weak-PIN rule, then offerBiometric. With one account on the phone the account PIN becomes the device PIN too, and the reverse (ADR 0086). Plays the success haptic when set.

turnOff.effect: Asks the device owner check (biometrics or the phone's passcode; the app PIN on a phone without a passcode), then removes the device PIN and the biometric unlock.

toggleBiometric.effect: Turns biometric unlock on (after a biometric check) or off.

lock.effect: When the app goes to the background and comes back after the grace time, or starts cold, with lockOn: shows the lock screen over everything. With biometricOn it asks for biometrics at once.

unlock.effect: Checks the typed PIN on the device. Right: hides the lock screen, success haptic. Wrong: phase wrongPin, error haptic, clears pin.

notes: The PIN check of the lock runs on the device; it never calls POST /v1/me/pin/check (API contract). The lock PIN is stored hashed on the device only.
Sign-up, sign-in, recovery and a PIN change never turn the lock on (ADR 0137). While the lock is on and the phone holds one account, a new account PIN also becomes the lock PIN.
Two accounts on the phone (ADR 0086): one device PIN for the lock; each account keeps its own server PIN for recovery.
Haptic ids: success for pin_set and app_unlock, error for pin_wrong (registries/haptics.json).

Bipe logic: BipeAppLock, BipeBiometricUnlock, BipeAccountSession.onAppLockPinSet, turnOffAppLock, verifyAppLockPin and hasSeparateDevicePin (Android account/), BipePIN (iOS). The lock screen UI itself is new code in bipe-app; the forks use Element's lock screen.

Open: the forks' lock screen comes from Element and its wrong-try limit and grace time are not specified by a Bipe ADR. bipe-app needs a decision (proposal: no sign-out after wrong tries, a growing wait after 5, grace time 0).
